summary: The runx getting-started walkthrough ended in a dead end for the receipt it had just sealed: the inspection step reports an unverified receipt, and the verify command that follows exits with a message naming a flag the docs never mention. This delivery fixes that page so a reader reaches the expected verdict without leaving the documented path, with both verdicts reproduced on the repository revision the docs ship from.
audience: Readers of docs/getting-started.md on runx-cli 0.9.1, and maintainers answering the same question in the issue tracker
venue: The runx repository itself: the gap is already reported in runxhq/runx#486, the project accepts docs pull requests, and CONTRIBUTING.md asks contributors to sign off under the DCO

observations.label: the delivered change
observations.note: one file, docs/getting-started.md, 41 lines added; branch docs/verify-local-development-flag on jonah791/runx; commit 2c26254 signed off under the DCO

observations.label: the gap this closes
observations.note: open issue describing the same dead end; the pull request states Fixes #486

observations.label: reproduction target
observations.note: the checked-in example examples/hello-world was run from that revision

observations.label: verify without a verifier configured
observations.value: runx verify <receipt-id> prints: runx: runx verify requires a trusted receipt verifier. Set both RUNX_RECEIPT_VERIFY_KID and RUNX_RECEIPT_VERIFY_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY_BASE64, configure a complete RUNX_RECEIPT_SIGN_* identity, or pass --allow-local-development-signatures for local fixture receipts only.
observations.note: the third option is the one that applies to the receipt the quickstart just sealed

observations.label: verify accepting the local-development signature
observations.value: runx verify <receipt-id> --allow-local-development-signatures prints signature mode: local-development, tree sha256:<receipt-id> (1 receipt): ok, verification: ok
observations.note: this is the verdict the added block documents, scoped to the local-development trust level

observations.label: what the page now says
observations.note: adds the unverified projection, the verifier-required message, the local-development verdict, and one sentence on what that verdict covers

observations.label: sign-off
observations.note: DCO trailer on the only commit, as CONTRIBUTING.md requires
